intent.instructions: Classify what the current user wants now. Use prior dialogue only to resolve references. Discussing possible work does not request execution.

criteria.task: Do project work: implement, fix, create tickets or spikes, delegate workers.

criteria.discussion: Discuss, research, explain, ask status or feasibility before doing work.

provenance: Synthetic development fixtures; not held-out or user-derived accuracy.
timing_boundary: Offline qualifier incl tokenization, synchronized MLX and JSON result formatting; excludes IPC, STT/TTS, Messenger and PM. Abstentions reported separately.
